periods.time: Revealed during Stella's confrontation with Or-Gaule
periods.label: 以处刑亲族为代价换取代表战的第一皇女

name.jp: ルナアイズ・ヴァーミリオン

status.current: offscreen, but her hidden bargain is exposed
status.condition: morally burdened by a self-imposed promise to execute her own family if Vermillion lost
status.goal: prevent all-out national war and minimize citizen casualties

personality.summary: Intelligent, noble and painfully self-sacrificing, willing to make herself the executor of an unbearable outcome to protect the people.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Younger sister whose realization of Lunaeyes's sacrifice intensifies her resolve against Or-Gaule.
relationships.or-gaule: Negotiated with him by offering the spectacle he wanted: her personally executing her family if Vermillion lost.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Father included among the family she would have had to execute under the bargain.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Family member whose life was part of the unbearable wager.

periods.summary: Lunaeyes does not appear directly in the chapter, but Or-Gaule reveals the price she paid to turn the conflict from a national clash into a representative war. After escaping Luxel with Alice's help, Lunaeyes returned by helicopter and proposed the League-rule war to avoid mass casualties. Or-Gaule initially refused because he did not care about League intervention, so Lunaeyes offered a grotesque incentive: if Vermillion lost and Quedland annexed it, she herself would execute the war criminals, meaning her parents and Stella. Or-Gaule accepted because the idea of Lunaeyes willingly killing loved ones promised exquisite emotional suffering. Stella realizes that Lunaeyes bore this nightmare alone to protect the people and directs her anger at Or-Gaule.

key_events.summary: Her self-sacrificial bargain with Or-Gaule is revealed as the reason the representative war happened.
